summary: Indepth Accounting is a Maroochydore QLD advisory-led firm founded in 2018 by Director Renee Cooper, named Regional/Suburban Firm of the Year at the 2026 Australian Accounting Awards. A August 2026 NAB feature says the 13-person team has been building custom AI agents and workflow automation, including a BAS process agent and a tax statement review agent.

sources.title: How Australian small businesses are using AI to save time and improve productivity
InDepth Accounting | Maroochydore Chamber of Commerce

Renee Cooper is the Founder and Director of Indepth Accounting.

hooks.text: Renee's team is actively building AI agents for BAS and tax review; reconciliation with an audit trail is a natural next workflow.
Renee frames AI as freeing people for advisory work, which matches Vert's pitch.
Recent national award gives a congratulatory opener and signals growth.

risks.text: Indepth builds its own AI agents and may prefer in-house automation over buying a tool; possible competitor-style overlap.

gaps: No hiring ads, Xero/MYOB partner status or podcast found.
